reasons: Both copies of addlist (boltons/dictutils.py and the private OrderedMultiDict in boltons/urlutils.py) now call `v = list(v)` before the truthiness check. That fully materialises any iterable once, keeps yield order, and means an empty iterator returns early without creating the key. Lists, tuples and ranges behave as before; the only cost is an extra list copy. QueryParamDict is a subclass of the urlutils OrderedMultiDict, so it gets the fix too. The diff only touches boltons/ and tests/. The tests it adds are thorough, and the only extra is a new test import, so scope is 2 rather than 3.
